action_args.justification: The series is strongly trend-dominated (trend strength 0.99) with moderate ranking stability (Kendall tau 0.4) and no single model consistently best across windows. The median over the 9 most stable models (pool3) provides robustness to the few redundant error groups and avoids the overfitting risk of fitted weights with only 3 validation windows. The leader's margin over the runner-up is statistically indistinguishable, and the full-pool median—despite lower raw RMSE—scores worse on the composite metric, confirming that the stable-subset median is the right balance of accuracy and consistency for this non-stationary, trend-heavy series.
